findings.message: Carry-forward from Phase 2 (T2.5) and Phase 3 (T3.2): the FR-4c workflow will return non-zero on its first invocation post-merge because the underlying .devcontainer/scripts/calibrate-gitnexus-grammar-skip.sh continues to return drift_detected (exit 2) against the live gitnexus@1.6.5. Phase 4's bundled-PR (T4.7) and the end-to-end smoke (T4.4) confirmed that the workflow YAML is correctly authored and that the in-repo mechanisms (FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4a, FR-4b named-failure path) all behave as designed; this finding is solely about the upstream-contract mismatch that will surface the first time the CI runner exercises the workflow. The expected behavior is documented in the bundled PR body so a reviewer is not surprised. Remediation belongs to a Phase 5 follow-on Issue or to the planned contract-redesign feature: re-research T-001 against live gitnexus@1.6.5 OR loosen signal_1 to the original D-0006 pre-tightening recommendation. NOT a Phase 4 BLOCKER. The Phase 4 bundle is otherwise complete and ready to merge.

findings.message: Pre-existing systemic validator-tool gap (carried forward from every prior phase). validate_pipeline_frontmatter.py reports MAJOR findings on any file lacking pipeline-doc YAML frontmatter. The validator is scoped to PRD/Blueprint/Plan/Tests/Validators only; smoke-report and ADR documents are out of its scope. Any findings the validator emits against these files are inapplicable false-positives. ADR-placement validator (the correct tool) is clean on all artifacts. Canonical placement and discipline checks pass cleanly. Not a Phase 4-introduced defect; the validator-scope gap needs to add path-prefix skips for adrs/ and working/.../smoke/ at the project-wide level outside this feature.
